# Nexus replies for 1.3.13

## HadToRegister: remember folded sections (posts, 26 Oct 9:37 AM)
Added in 1.3.13: a category you fold with - stays folded the next time you play. Thanks for the idea!

## Delacroix: un-hide beaten bosses, show undiscovered places (posts, 26 Oct 6:28 AM)
Thanks! Both are in 1.3.13. Ctrl + left click now works on every boss: on a beaten one it marks it not beaten. Beaten bosses aren't drawn while Looted Chests is on Hide, so switch Settings > Looted Chests to Grayed Out to see them and click. And places you haven't discovered yet are now grayed out, even where the fog is cleared, so you can tell which ones you still have to find.
